subject: Stacy Keach
title: Stacy Keach death: 'Mike Hammer' and 'Prison Break' actor dies at 85
answer: Actor Stacy Keach, best known as TV private eye Mike Hammer and as Warden Henry Pope on "Prison Break," died Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, at age 85. His wife, Malgosia Tomassi Keach, said he died at their home in Magdalenka, Poland, of heart failure after a long illness.
in_the_news: News of his death spread on Nov. 10 and 11, 2026, and his Wikipedia page drew more than 560,000 views in a single day as fans looked back on a career that spanned six decades of film, TV and stage.
body:
Keach was born June 2, 1941, in Savannah, Georgia. He studied at the University of California, Berkeley, the Yale School of Drama and, as a Fulbright scholar, the London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art. He built his reputation on the stage and was regarded as one of the leading American interpreters of Shakespeare, eventually playing King Lear. He earned a Tony nomination for playing Buffalo Bill in the Broadway play "Indians."

On screen, he starred in John Huston's boxing drama "Fat City" (1972) and played Sgt. Stedenko in Cheech and Chong's "Up in Smoke" (1978). His signature TV role was Mickey Spillane's hard-boiled detective in "Mike Hammer" on CBS in the mid-1980s, a part he returned to in the late 1990s. He won a Golden Globe for playing Ernest Hemingway in the 1988 miniseries "Hemingway." Later generations knew him as Ken Titus, the father on the Fox sitcom "Titus," and as Warden Pope on "Prison Break" (2005-2007). Film roles in later years included "American History X," "Nebraska" and "Jay Kelly" (2025), in which he played George Clooney's father.

In 2017, Keach suffered a heart attack onstage in Chicago during the opening of "Pamplona," a one-man play about Hemingway. He is survived by his wife and his children, Shannon and Karolina. His younger brother is actor and director James Keach.

faq.a: His wife said he died of heart failure caused by a serious heart condition, after a long illness.
At his home in Magdalenka, Poland, near Warsaw.

faq.q: Who did Stacy Keach play in Prison Break?
faq.a: Henry Pope, the warden of Fox River State Penitentiary, in the first seasons of the show (2005-2007).

faq.q: Is James Keach related to Stacy Keach?
faq.a: Yes. James Keach, an actor and director, is his younger brother.
